title: 636017 Move Manufacturing report action tooltips to report objects
summary: Manufacturing report action tooltips are moved from page actions to report objects themselves, allowing tooltips to be defined once and inherited across all pages that invoke the reports.
key_points: Tooltips for 7 manufacturing reports (Capacity Task List, Inventory Valuation - WIP, Prod. Order - Shortage List, Production Order Statistics, Quantity Explosion of BOM, Subcontractor - Dispatch List, Where-Used Top Level) moved from pages to reports
Leverages the 2025 release wave 1 feature where running objects in actions defaults to UI descriptors on target object
Duplicate tooltip entries removed from 15 pages and role centers across W1 and IT layers
Completes the manufacturing area migration with 0 remaining items to classify
quote: Moves the report action ToolTips for 7 Manufacturing reports off the page actions that run them and onto the report objects themselves.
